regime_notes: No ecosystem or asset crossed a fresh prospective paper-trade threshold in this scan. No generated position developed a structural failure or thesis deterioration strong enough to justify a trim or exit.

Solana remains the strongest observed high-velocity spot/RWA venue in the current research set. Same-day reporting still shows roughly $2.6B of DEX volume and substantive tokenized-equity secondary trading, but fresh reporting also characterizes stablecoin retention and net inflows as limited. The Raydium venue thesis therefore remains stronger than the RAY asset-entry thesis; no new selective-wallet accumulation or distribution reversal was verified after the previously frozen no-trade observation.

BNB Chain tokenized-equity usage is financially substantive rather than issuance-only: recent reporting shows large completed bStocks secondary volume, including $180.5M weekend volume in QQQB and more than $5.2B cumulative tokenized-stock volume on the chain. However, Binance's official US Stocks MegaFest runs Sep 3-Oct 8 with rewards explicitly tied to bStocks trading thresholds and referrals. Current bStocks user/volume growth is therefore materially incentive-contaminated and cannot qualify as clean discretionary migration. CAKE also remains structurally rejected under the framework because its previously documented owner-controlled mint/admin authority has not been shown to be cryptographically removed.

AERO is approximately $0.5738 versus the $0.5596 gross paper entry. Base's tokenized-equity secondary-trading thesis remains valid, but no new independent smart-money cohort or renewed venue-volume acceleration was verified; Solana/Raydium competition remains a monitor rather than an exit trigger.

HYPE is approximately $79.78 versus the $79.35 gross entry. Reports surfaced in this scan largely repeat the pre-entry whale accumulation and buyback/burn evidence. Short-term leverage remains a risk, but no protocol structural failure or independent distribution reversal was verified; no trim and no add.

SUI continues to have an interesting stablecoin-growth backdrop, but no sufficiently abnormal current DEX/perp acceleration or selective-wallet convergence was verified. Arbitrum's prior watch-only reacceleration likewise lacks a direct enough token-value-capture path and fresh retained-capital confirmation.
